subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Does the browser/proxy owner approve replacing Playwright's HTTP discovery fallback with OpenClaw-controlled discovery and exact managed-proxy leases for both discovery routes and the derived WebSocket?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but this deliberately changes the authority boundary for CDP discovery and proxy bypass at an SSRF-sensitive surface; tests cannot determine whether maintainers want that fail-closed contract for all remote providers.

options.title: Approve exact controlled discovery
options.body: Accept OpenClaw-owned discovery and exact lifecycle-bound leases, then merge after rebasing and confirming the security checks on the final head.

options.title: Preserve an HTTP fallback
options.body: Require a narrowly specified compatibility path for remote providers, with proof that it cannot escape the configured proxy and SSRF policy.

options.title: Pause for provider evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until affected remote-CDP provider behavior is inventoried and the intended compatibility contract is documented.

recommendation.title: Approve exact controlled discovery
recommendation.body: Accept OpenClaw-owned discovery and exact lifecycle-bound leases, then merge after rebasing and confirming the security checks on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the existing loopback CDP proxy-bypass behavior and has the strongest direct history with the invariant being extended.
